summary: Sandbach United are putting the finishing touches on preparations for the 2026/27 season, which kicks off in just one week. The squad has been bolstered with several new signings and a returning player, along with three brand new kits, while the club is actively seeking sponsorship opportunities to support the campaign. In their recent friendly against St Helens, the Ramblers showed promise but were undone by their opponents' clinical finishing.
